summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload unrelated to Babel plugin purpose
details: Package presents as a Babel plugin transforming @linaria/core and @linaria/react imports to undefined (lib/index.js is a plausible ~80-line AST transform), but package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs", and setup.mjs is a hex-identifier-obfuscated script that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory and then invokes the downloaded Bun binary to execute a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~700KB heavily obfuscated blob using shuffled string arrays, array-rotation decoders, and random identifiers, and is not referenced by the advertised Babel plugin code. The alternate-runtime fetch specifically routes execution through Bun rather than Node, bypassing Node-based analysis. Fetching a second runtime purely to execute an obfuscated sibling at install time is unrelated to the package's stated purpose and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape; the Babel plugin file functions as cover for the install-time payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
